page_title: FRE 1-4 RBL | Freiburg v RB Leipzig 06/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+3' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Substitution. Xavi Simons leaves the pitch and is replaced by Lukas Klostermann (RB Leipzig).
88' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Freiburg.
86' Christian Streich has decided to substitute Yannik Keitel and he is replaced by Maximilian Philipp (Freiburg).
86' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) will replace Merlin Rohl.
83' Marco Rose decides to make a substitution. Benjamin Sesko will be replaced by Eljif Elmas (RB Leipzig).
83' Amadou Haidara goes off the pitch and Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig) comes on.
82' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
80' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. Freiburg have a corner.
80' Yellow card! It's like Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Daniel Siebert agrees and books him.
76' The substitution has been made. Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) has replaced Dani Olmo.
75' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Lucas Holer walks off the pitch to be replaced by Roland Sallai (Freiburg).
75' The expression of the referee Daniel Siebert is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) is shown a yellow card.
75' Marco Rose prepares a substitution. Benjamin Henrichs is replaced by Mohamed Simakan (RB Leipzig).
73' Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) tries to convince the referee to change his mind and receives a yellow card for dissent.
70' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.
68' Today's referee Daniel Siebert rightly decides to book David Raum (RB Leipzig) for his harsh tackle.
67' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
66' Freiburg take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
65' It's like he was asking for a caution. Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) receives a yellow card.
64' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) infringed the rules and goes into the book. Daniel Siebert pulls out a yellow card.
64' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Freiburg have been awarded a corner kick.
62' The ball possession is 44:56.
60' 1 - 4 Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) latches onto a deep cross on the edge of the penalty box and scores a beautiful goal after firing the ball inside the right post!
58' RB Leipzig are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
54' 0 - 4 Goal - 0:4! Lois Openda tees up Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom left corner and past Noah Atubolu.
53' A corner kick by Freiburg is thwarted by the well prepared Peter Gulacsi (RB Leipzig).
52' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
49' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Christian Gunter (Freiburg).

48' A clever short pass gives Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Freiburg will have a goal kick.
47' Freiburg take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
47' Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
46' The game is over for Lukas Kubler (Freiburg). Kiliann Sildillia comes on for the second half.
46' Half-time substitution. Christian Streich decided to make a change. Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) is replaced by Vincenzo Grifo.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+9' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+8' Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
45+6' David Raum (RB Leipzig) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
45+5' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
45+4' Dani Olmo (RB Leipzig) latches on to a through ball inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in with a timely interception. It could have been a great chance otherwise.
45' We will have 8 min. of added time.

44' 0 - 3 GOAL! A terrible mistake leads to a goal. The defender ends up losing possession, allowing Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) to pick up the ball before slotting it into the back of the net to make it 0:3.
44' The corner by Christian Gunter (Freiburg) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
43' Daniel Siebert blows his whistle as Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
42' Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
41' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) fails to score from the penalty spot! His effort only crashes against the crossbar.
40' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) is going to take the penalty!
40' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Freiburg!
39' Referee Daniel Siebert makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
39' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
37' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

37' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The referee blows his whistle, Freiburg are awarded a corner kick.
35' The corner from Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) is hurriedly cleared.

35' Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Noah Atubolu has it covered and makes a comfortable save. Corner kick. RB Leipzig will have an opportunity.
34' Dani Olmo (RB Leipzig) is penalised for a foul. Daniel Siebert had a clear view and blows his whistle.
30' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
27' David Raum (RB Leipzig) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
25' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the left post. Noah Atubolu is alert and denies him with a nice save.
22' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) commits a foul and Daniel Siebert immediately signals a free kick.
18' 0 - 2 Goal! Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 0:2.
17' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play.
16' Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play. RB Leipzig are awarded a corner kick.
14' Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.

13' A precise low pass is received by Lucas Holer (Freiburg), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.
13' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
12' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. It will be a corner kick for Freiburg.
11' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
9' Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Freiburg will have a goal kick.
8' A long ball forward to Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) is intercepted.
8' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by David Raum (RB Leipzig) but poses no threat.
6' David Raum (RB Leipzig) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.

5' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
4' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
2' 0 - 1 Goal! Lois Openda produces a great pass that finds Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the bottom left corner. 0:1.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. RB Leipzig will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Daniel Siebert.
